name: Skazanija drevnih el'fov: Skazka na noch'
original_name: Сказания древних эльфов: Сказка на ночь
source:
Start your adventure in the heart of the forest, where winding paths will lead you to a small elven village that hides many secrets and untold stories.

Immerse yourself in a magical world, solving mysteries and making your own rules: now you can change the world any way you want.

Explore the history of the elven race, listen to the stories of local bards, and enjoy the landscapes of a magical world in the game "Tales of the Ancient Elves: Night's Tale".

[from [url=https://by-vishnevskaya.itch.io/talesoftheancientelves]Itch.io[/url]]
